quantumReadiness.title: Cybersecurity & Quantum Readiness
quantumReadiness.subtitle: Quantum Readiness as a Service — aligned with NIST PQC standards
quantumReadiness.intro: Quantum computing threatens widely deployed RSA, ECC, and TLS cryptography. Heritage InfoTech helps regulated enterprises inventory cryptographic assets, rank harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure, and plan hybrid PQC migration paths — without disrupting mission-critical operations.

tiles.title: Quantum Readiness Assessments
tiles.summary: Executive and technical assessments mapping quantum threat timelines, regulatory obligations, and phased migration readiness across your enterprise.

tiles.title: Cryptographic Discovery
tiles.summary: Expert-led inventory, supported by our tooling, of certificates, keys, algorithms, and embedded cryptography across applications, infrastructure, and third-party dependencies.

tiles.title: HNDL Exposure and Risk Ranking
tiles.summary: Prioritizes what to migrate first by linking quantum-vulnerable cryptography to the sensitive data it protects, weighted by how long that data must stay confidential, and flags where evidence is incomplete instead of assuming it's safe.

tiles.title: Hybrid PQC Migration Planning and Support
tiles.summary: Phased migration planning for hybrid classical + NIST-standard PQC algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) across PKI, TLS, and application encryption.
